# PlayableYet

> Public index of PlayStation 3, 4, and 5 compatibility reports. It does not host games or link to ROMs, firmware, BIOS images, or decryption keys.

PlayableYet copies public reports from RPCS3, shadPS4, fpPS4, SharpEmu, KytyPS5, and the AnyPS5 porting layer into one catalog. Status words stay the ones the source used.

## Start here

- [Home](https://playableyet.vercel.app/): Search and filter the catalog. Shows newly playable titles and status changes.
- [About](https://playableyet.vercel.app/about): Sources, status definitions, and the AnyPS5 warning.
- [Full guide](https://playableyet.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Status meanings, data sources, and URL patterns.
- [Sitemap](https://playableyet.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Every game page.
- [Search index](https://playableyet.vercel.app/search-index.json): Public catalog fields used by the browser. No email addresses or watch tokens.

## Game pages

- [Game](https://playableyet.vercel.app/games/{slug}): One title. `{slug}` is lowercase hyphenated words, for example `/games/dreaming-sarah`. The page title asks “Is {Game} playable yet?” and the description lists platform and project statuses from that snapshot. The page includes schema.org VideoGame structured data with each project's status id (`playable`, `ingame`, `intro`, `menus`, `loadable`, `boots`, `in-bring-up`, `nothing`). The home page includes WebSite and, when the week has them, ItemList structured data for the newly playable rows shown on the page.
